tasks.short: Research and evaluate emerging instructional technologies

steps.what: Research emerging instructional technologies and retrieve relevant evidence and documentation
Evaluate evidence quality, instructional fit and technology limitations through review and trials

tasks.design: Configure saved searches and source bookmarks in {DOCS} to retrieve relevant evidence. The coordinator retains critical reading, practical trials and educational evaluation; retrieval does not rank technologies or recommend adoption automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated discovery and navigation of familiar evidence sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches can reduce repeated retrieval work.
tasks.still_hard: Vendor claims and results in another setting may not predict educational value locally.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a useful teaching method from an impressive demonstration.
tasks.altitude: A little less source navigation with unchanged evaluation responsibility.

reach.task: Plan a limited trial of an emerging instructional tool
reach.learn: Useful comparison measures and implementation limits

evidence.claim: The digest reports an English trial of Aila lesson preparation with lower preparation time and no worse quality; this is evidence for evaluating that use case, not a saving for coordinator research.
Saved searches and source bookmarks can shorten repeated retrieval while leaving evaluation unchanged.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator research and evaluation, excluding adoption, procurement, routine teaching and personal learner assessment.

Coordinator defines the evaluation question, search terms, date range and source scope in s1; capture and screening remain within its 60% time. Publishers and vendors supply existing source documents with unchanged production effort. Missing or stale evidence requires manual search in s1 and is reported as uncertainty in s2.

Test native search configuration before custom code. Evaluation and trial time retain all baseline effort. No individual pupil data is needed for document retrieval; any later live trial needs its own authorised scope.
research_questions: Do saved searches reduce navigation without missing contrary or recent evidence?

already_counted.description: Set search scope and screen source relevance

incremental.description: Maintain search sources and remove stale bookmarks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=94; gross 6 less upkeep 1 gives net 5. High assumes repeated source navigation; low assumes novel topics require full manual discovery. Evaluation retains 85 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach instructors to integrate instructional technology

steps.what: Prepare technology demonstrations and practice materials for instructors' teaching context
Teach instructors, observe practice and coach integration with teaching

tasks.design: Reuse native training templates and approved sections in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The coordinator checks the current interface and demonstration, then retains all live teaching, observed practice and coaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated assembly of standard demonstrations and practice sheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Native content reuse can preserve checked instructions and layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Instructors need help connecting tool operation with a specific teaching purpose.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when successful clicking conceals misunderstanding about classroom use.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation assembly with unchanged coaching time and authority.

reach.task: Adapt a demonstrated technique to a real lesson
reach.learn: Pedagogical purpose, accessibility and fallback teaching methods

evidence.claim: Reusable native training sections can reduce material assembly while preserving current-version checks and practical coaching.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator preparation and teaching, excluding instructors' practice time and later lesson preparation.

Coordinator identifies audience, teaching scenario, software version and needed practice in s1; capture, adaptation and demonstration testing remain in its 60% time. Existing guidance owners keep their documentation work. Unmatched versions or scenarios use manual preparation rather than stale instructions.
Test native content reuse before custom code or model generation. All live teaching remains, no learner personal data is required, and existing software runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Rate of interface changes and instructor support needs
research_questions: Does material reuse shorten preparation after testing the demonstration on the current version?

already_counted.description: Adapt materials and check current demonstration behaviour

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=88; gross 12 minus upkeep 2 gives net 10. High assumes recurring training topics; low assumes changed interfaces and bespoke needs consume reuse gains. Live teaching retains 70 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The coordinator keeps critical technology evaluation and practical instructor coaching, with less repetitive retrieval and assembly.
reach: Help teachers plan limited technology trials and adapt demonstrated methods to lessons
role.ambitious_version: Support careful technology adoption through tested demonstrations and explicit evidence limits.
